front: Cervical length (CL) binh thuong o tam thai ky la bao nhieu? Dinh nghia theo Hughes IPDMA 2026?
back: CL binh thuong trung binh: 40 mm (SD 9 mm) theo Hughes 2026. Nguong 'binh thuong moi' nen la >= 40 mm (khong phai 25 mm nhu cu). Phan vi 10 cua CL trong quan the chung: ~25 mm (Iams 1996).
extra: PMID 42228679 (Hughes 2026 IPDMA, n=91,204 singleton, 12 quoc gia)

front: Moi quan h giua CL va SPTB theo Hughes 2026 IPDMA la gi?
back: Moi quan he L-shape (duong cong chu L). CL tu 10-40 mm: SPTB tang manh theo ham mu khi CL giam. CL > 40 mm: OR gan nhu flat (1.0-1.2) - khong con gia tri tien luong. CL 20 mm: OR 6.22 SPTB <37 tuan (so voi 40 mm).

front: Moi quan he giua CL va SPTB o SONG THAI co khac singleton khong?
back: CO. O twin moi quan he TUYEN TINH (linear) khong phai L-shape. Moi 1 mm CL giam → SPTB <34 tuan tang 6.8% (HR 0.93). Khong co nguong cat ro rang. Baseline SPTB rat cao o twin (44.9% <37 tuan).

front: Nguong CL < 25 mm co y nghia gi?
back: CL < 25 mm o 18-24 tuan = 'short cervix' (co tu cung ngan) - nguong can thiep. SPTB rate tang 20-40% o nhom nay. La nguong co dien cho progesterone va/hoac cerclage.

front: Tai sao co che sinh hoc co tu cung ngan dan den SPTB?
back: CT ngan = qua trinh softening/ripening xay ra som hon binh thuong. Co che: (1) viem/decidual activation (TNFα, IL-1β, IL-6 tang), (2) hormone: thieu progesterone → ripening som, (3) collagen yeu (COL1A1, COL5A1 polymorphism), (4) ap luc co hoc (da thai, da on, khoi u), (5) tien su can thiep CT (LEEP, cone).

front: 8 buoc do CL qua TV theo Iams va Fetal Medicine Foundation?
back: (1) Bang quang rong, tu the lithotomy, dau do 5-9 MHz; (2) Dat dau do nhe, cho 30 giay; (3) Mat cat sagittal, thay ong CT + internal os + external os; (4) Zoom CT chiem 75% man hinh; (5) Do tip-to-tip tu internal os den external os; (6) 3 lan do lay shortest best; (7) Tranh ep CT; (8) Ghi nhan them funneling, sludge, dynamic shortening.

front: PROM-PROM 2011 trial cho thay progesterone am dao co hieu qua gi o CL <= 15 mm?
back: Fonseca 2011 (NEJM): progesterone 200 mg am dao o CL <= 15 mm → giam SPTB 44% (RR 0.56, 95% CI 0.36-0.86) so voi placebo. N=413 phu nu, multicenter, 5 quoc gia.

front: OPPTIMUM 2016 trial ket luan gi ve progesterone am dao o phu nu tien su SPTB?
back: Norman 2016 (NEJM): progesterone 200 mg o phu nu tien su SPTB → KHONG giam SPTB o population chung (RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.74-1.27), nhung co trend giam o subgroup CL < 25 mm. N=1,228 phu nu.

front: 3 loai cerclage va chi dinh cua chung?
back: (1) History-indicated: >= 3 lan sinh non/say muon (16-34 tuan), khau luc 12-14 tuan; (2) Ultrasound-indicated: tien su >= 1 SPTB <34 tuan + CL < 25 mm, khau ngay; (3) Physical exam (rescue): CT mo >= 1 cm + mang oi phong, khau khan sau khi loai tru nhiem trung/go/vo oi.

front: 3 ky thuat cerclage va dac diem?
back: (1) McDonald: don gian, khau mui tui (purse-string) o 4 vi tri quanh CT, pho bien nhat. (2) Shirodkar: bong bang quang-truc trang, khau cao hon qua ngach truoc, ky thuat kho. (3) Transabdominal cerclage (TAC): khau qua noi soi o bung, dat giua CT va TC, giu nguyen den sinh mo - cho truong hop nang, that bai McDonald/Shirodkar.

front: Khi nao cerclage co hieu qua theo Owen 2009 meta-analysis?
back: Cerclage hieu qua o phu nu co tien su SPTB + CL < 25 mm: giam SPTB <35 tuan (RR 0.61), giam tu vong chu sinh (RR 0.64). O phu nu KHONG co tien su + CL ngan: KHONG co loi, tham chi tang nguy co PROM.

front: PECEP 2012 trial va ProTWIN 2015 trial ket luan gi ve pessary?
back: PECEP 2012 (Goya, Lancet): pessary o CL < 25 mm + singleton → giam SPTB <34 tuan (RR 0.18, 95% CI 0.04-0.78). ProTWIN 2015 (Liem, NEJM): pessary o song thai CL < 38 mm → KHONG giam SPTB. Pessary hieu qua o singleton nghen dou, khong ro o twin.

front: van Dijk 2025 trial so sanh pessary va progesterone o song thai the nao?
back: van Dijk 2025 (PLoS Med, RCT): o song thai co CL ngan, pessary KHONG vuot troi progesterone am dao trong du phong SPTB. Progesterone van la first-line o song thai co CT ngan.

front: Fetal fibronectin (fFN) co vai tro gi trong du doan SPTB?
back: fFN >= 50 ng/mL trong dich am dao 22-34 tuan: NPV 99% cho SPTB trong 14 ngay (dung de LOAI TRU). PPV thap (~15-20%) - khong dung de CHAN DOAN. Ket hop CL + fFN cai thien du doan SPTB.

front: ACOG 2024 khuyen cao gi ve sang loc CL dai tra?
back: ACOG 2024 Practice Bulletin No.234: do CL qua TV cho TAT CA thai phu singleton o 18-22 tuan (Level B). USPSTF 2023: chua du bang chung (I-statement). Nam 2026 nhieu trung tam lon o My/Au ap dung universal screening.

front: Subgroup analysis Hughes 2026 cho thay CL co gia tri tien luong the nao o nhom tien su phau thuat CT va tien su SPTB?
back: (1) Tien su phau thuat CT (LEEP/cone): CL co gia tri tien luong MANH HON (CL < 28 mm). (2) Tien su sinh non: CL co gia tri tien luong YEU HON (CL < 25 mm) - nhom nay da co nguy co nen. (3) Di tat tu cung: khong co tuong tac - van nguy co cao bat ke CL.

front: Cervical index (CI) la gi? Y nghia?
back: CI = CL × (1 + funneling%/100) - phan anh ca do dai va do mo co tu cung. O nulliparous: CI > 0.5 o 18-24 tuan tang nguy co SPTB gap 2-3 lan. Funneling don thuan (ngay ca khi CL > 25 mm) van la dau hieu canh bao.

front: Co che progesterone uc che ripening co tu cung?
back: (1) Giam COX-2 → giam prostaglandin; (2) Uc che NF-κB → giam cytokine viem; (3) Duy tri cau truc collagen; (4) Can tro qua trinh softening som. Lieu: 200 mg/dem am dao, tu 16-24 tuan den 36 tuan. Tac dung phu: it, co the discharge am dao nhe.

front: 4 khang dinh thay doi guideline tu 2014 sang 2026?
back: (1) Nguong 'binh thuong' moi: >= 40 mm (Hughes 2026), khong con 25 mm. (2) Universal screening: ACOG 2024 ung ho (Level B). (3) CL > 40 mm: gan nhu khong con gia tri tien luong. (4) Pessary: khong con first-line, chi khi progesterone/cerclage khong kha thi.

front: Lieu progesterone, cerclage, pessary - cai nao first-line cho CL < 25 mm khong co tien su SPTB?
back: Progesterone 200 mg am dao la FIRST-LINE cho CL < 25 mm bat ke tien su (PROM-PROM 2011). Cerclage chi them khi co tien su SPTB (>= 1 lan). Pessary du tru, chi khi progesterone/cerclage khong kha thi.

front: IGFBP-3 ket hop CL co y nghia gi theo Mhernchan 2026?
back: Mhernchan 2026: IGFBP-3 huyet thanh thap + CL ngan = SPTB risk CONG HOP. Co the ket hop biomarker trong tuong lai de cai thien sang loc. IGFBP-3 thap phan anh suy thai va stress nhan thai som.
